description: This file defines structures and logic for displaying and managing tool representations within the OpenClawKit framework. It includes a summary struct for tools, a registry for configuration, and functions for resolving display details based on configuration, inputs, and external resources.

classes.name: ToolDisplaySummary
classes.description: A struct representing summarized display information for a tool, including its name, emoji, title, label, verb, and detail.

classes.name: ToolDisplayRegistry
classes.description: A singleton-like enum providing configuration for tool display specifications, with functions to resolve display summaries from inputs and configs.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a ToolDisplaySummary for a tool name, arguments, and optional meta information based on a loaded configuration.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Loads and decodes the JSON configuration for tool display from external resources.

methods.name: defaultConfig
methods.description: Provides a default configuration if external config fails to load.

methods.name: titleFromName
methods.description: Generates a user-friendly title from a raw tool name.

methods.name: normalizeVerb
methods.description: Normalizes verb strings by trimming and replacing underscores.

methods.name: readDetail
methods.description: Creates a detail string for read-type tools based on path, offset, and limit.

methods.name: pathDetail
methods.description: Extracts the path detail from arguments.

methods.name: firstValue
methods.description: Retrieves the first matching value from args based on a list of keys.

methods.name: renderValue
methods.description: Renders a value into a string preview, handling various data types.

methods.name: valueForKeyPath
methods.description: Accesses nested values in arguments using a key path.

methods.name: shortenHomeInString
methods.description: Replaces the home directory path in strings with ~ for brevity.
